Definition: from G4862 and a derivative of G473; to meet with; figuratively, to occur:--befall, meet.
BiblicalUsage: When Jesus comes down from the mount, much people meet Him, and the writer of Hebrews says Melchisedec, king of Salem and priest of the most high God, met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him. Meetings in Scripture are rarely accidents; they are appointments, and the blessing comes in the meeting.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that God arranges meetings, and I hold that the blessing of Melchisedec still falls on those who meet the Lord on the road.
